note: D2 — every model id this catalogue has ever published, sorted. `npm run catalog:build` appends to it and never removes from it. An id that leaves catalog-src without a tombstone fails the build (§10.2 check 2), because nothing in the database can follow a rename: collection_items.model_id is a plain string with no foreign key, so permanence is the only integrity mechanism this system has. Commit this file with the catalogue change that produced it.
